caption:
Chicken Kheema Dosa

C: 22 | F: 13 | P: 31
Calories: 330 per serving
Serves 4

Ingredients
1 tbsp oil
1 tsp jeera
1 onion, finely chopped
1 tsp garlic paste + 1 tsp ginger paste
2 green chillies, sliced
4-5 tomatoes, blended
1/4 cup water, added to the blender to remove the exxtras
450 grams chicken kheema 
1.5 tsp red chilli powder + 1 tsp coriander powder + 1 tsp haldi + 1 tsp garam masala + 1 tsp jeera powder + 1 tsp salt
handful of coriander
dosa batter , i use id ready made
optional: podi and cheese in the dosa
